## Description

Applies fractional integration and fractional differencing (using memory parameters $d$) to spread series to extract long-memory mean-reverting properties in cointegrated assets.

## Where it may fit

Asset pairs with slow, persistent reversion where standard integer-differenced cointegration tests fail.

## Vehicles

Statistical arbitrage desks, quantitative macro funds.

## Required data

Historical price series of paired assets, Augmented Dickey-Fuller / fractional unit root test statistics.

## Caveats

Estimating the fractional differencing parameter $d$ accurately requires sufficient historical depth without look-ahead bias.
